entries.reason: IBM CICS POST (SET): the timer-event control area is created as binary zeros, and POST AFTER SECONDS(5) with no condition (RESP NORMAL, the only answer the scenario's fixed request can get) hands its address over; 'IF LS-TEC = LOW-VALUES' false needs a non-zero area before any WAIT, which IBM never describes. Register X63.

IBM CICS POST / WAIT EVENT: once WAIT EVENT ECADDR on a POST's area returns NORMAL, the area is posted ('its first byte is set to X'40' and its third byte to X'80''), so 'IF LS-TEC(1:1) = X'40' AND LS-TEC(3:1) = X'80'' always holds; the fixed POST AFTER SECONDS(5) and WAIT give no scenario input that makes either answer a condition. Register X63.
